verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a dedicated test-account environment with public signup and per-scenario testing guides covering payments, test cards, disputes, fraud detection, bank payouts, and AVS/ANI checks. A separate sandbox endpoint (cko.tech) confirms the sandbox is distinct from production. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of decline-specific test cards, documentation that the sandbox mirrors production behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
